from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyPrepaidData(BaseModel):
    """One company's prepaid items amount from their financial report for the relevant period."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name as reported")
    prepaid_items_amount: float | None = Field(description="The prepaid items amount reported, in Yuan")
    prepaid_label: str | None = Field(description="The line-item label as written in the report")
    unit: str | None = Field(description="The currency unit: 'Yuan', 'yuan', etc.")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period the figure covers")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim excerpt containing the prepaid items label and amount")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_prepaid_items: list[CompanyPrepaidData]
